item.title: Q-GAIN：用于机器学习与物理信息分析应用的Python软件包
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 M. Doris, S. Guo, S. M. Koh, L. Ritter, A. R. Fritsch, S. Mukherjee, I. B. Spielman, J. P. Zwolak
该论文介绍量子气体分析与推断Python软件包Q-GAIN，用于在冷原子实验中快速部署机器学习和物理信息分析技术。该软件包内置了针对原子玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚体图像的分类、目标检测和物理信息特征识别指标，并支持从数据载入、预处理、机器学习识别到传统分析的模块化流程。作者通过MNIST数字分类、孤子激发检测以及环形BEC中量子化涡旋识别三个任务展示了其适用性。

item.title: 基于不可约笛卡尔自然张量的原子尺度机器学习
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Qun Chen, A. S. L. Subrahmanyam Pattamatta, Boyu Wang, David J. Srolovitz, Mingjian Wen
本文提出笛卡尔自然张量网络，为原子尺度机器学习提供一种保持对称性的通用框架。作者发展了基于笛卡尔自然张量的不可约表示理论，包括张量构造、乘积以及高阶物理张量的分解与重构。该方法可构建等变机器学习原子间势，在材料和分子体系中的表现可与主流球谐模型相当，并能准确描述从偶极矩到弹性常数张量等多种张量性质。

item.title: 通过分子机器学习提升聚合物电解质燃料电池中氧还原反应的质量活性
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Ekaterina Gracheva, Shin-ichi Yamazaki, Guillaume Lambard, Keitaro Sodeyama, Tsutomu Ioroi and Masafumi Asahi
该研究将主动学习用于实验发现可提升聚合物电解质燃料电池 Pt 阴极催化剂氧还原质量活性的有机添加剂。作者基于初始有机化合物数据训练神经网络，并通过多轮主动学习、可实验性约束和分子生成筛选候选分子，模型预测误差逐步降低。实验发现三聚氰胺二聚体 melam 可显著提高质量活性，说明主动学习在低数据量燃料电池添加剂发现中具有可行性。

item.title: Enerzyme: A Framework for Efficient Training of Reactive Neural Network Potentials for Enzyme Catalysis with Application to Methyltransferases
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Weiliang Luo, Heather J. Kulik
arXiv:2607.01362v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum mechanical (QM) cluster models provide an effective framework for mechanistic studies of enzymatic reactions but remain computationally demanding. Neural network potentials (NNPs) offer a promising route to reduce this cost, but enzymes present challenges beyond small molecules, including large system sizes, implicit-solvent environments, substantial polarization, and charge transfer. Here, we present an integrated software framework for efficient NNP training for mechanistic studies of enzymes, demonstrated on QM cluster models of S-adenosyl-L-methionine-dependent methyltransferases (MTases). Our Enerzyme code introduces modular electrostatics-aware NNP architectures and combines automated QM-cluster construction with reactive datas…

item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Giacomo Cappiello, Filippo Caruso, Xing Liang, Dimitrios Makris

item.title: Design of Cooperative Converter with Optimized Deep Learning based Control Mechanism of Battery Cell Balancing for Automotive Applications
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Hemalatha.M, Sampoornam K P
This paper presents a high power density battery cell balancing system for the electro-mobility application that integrates a voltage step-up and a cell balancing function in one converter topology. The Co-operative conversion technique is used and realized by means of a number of dual active bridge (CO-DAB) converter modules. The converter processes only a portion of the output power, proportional to the difference in voltage of the battery pack and the converter output, thus a smaller converter can be designed than conventional solutions. Furthermore, it does lead to more efficient power processing at the system level as well. The modular structure of the converter allows multiple connection to each battery cell for online cell balancing in the case of standstill, charging, and discharg…

item.title: An Optimisation Framework for the Well-Conditioned Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Joseph Webb, Sadok Jerad, Coralia Cartis
arXiv:2607.02194v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a promising route to solve partial differential equations, yet they have struggled to reach the precision of classical solvers. The obstacle is increasingly understood to be one of optimisation, owing to the severely ill-conditioned loss landscape. We present DSGNAR: Doubly-Sketched Gauss-Newton with Adaptive Ratio, a scalable second-order optimisation framework that confronts this ill-conditioning and, in doing so, obtains unprecedented accuracy and speed. DSGNAR couples a doubly-sketched Gauss-Newton model with a novel strategy that carefully controls both regularisation and step length. Across a suite of problems spanning nonlinear, chaotic, multi-scale, high-dimensional, and Navi…

item.title: 磁振子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的铁电性：非互易超流、例外点与 Majorana 玻色子
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Kazuki Yamamoto, Takuto Kawakami, Mikito Koshino
该研究探讨磁振子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体通过几何 Aharonov-Casher 相位与电场耦合所产生的铁电不稳定性。基于玻色 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 平均场理论，作者指出电场诱导的磁振子轨道运动会产生电极化，并通过正反馈触发自发铁电相变和持久磁振子超流。铁电相中准粒子谱呈非互易性；在临界点，BdG 哈密顿量在整个布里渊区出现本征值与本征矢合并的例外点，并产生具有粒子-空穴对称特征的 Majorana 型玻色激发。

item.title: 非共线反铁磁体中温度不变的磁光克尔效应
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Camron Farhang, Weihang Lu, Yuchuan Yao, Pratap Pal, Shaofeng Han, Jian-Guo Zheng, Hua Chen, Chang-Beom Eom, Jing Xia
该研究在外延化学计量 Mn3NiN 单晶薄膜中，于 1550 nm 红外通信波长下测量极向磁光克尔效应。作者首次观察到在低于 Néel 温度的约 200 K 范围内仅有少量变化的自发克尔信号，表明其主要反映内禀 Berry 曲率响应。与同一样品中受外禀偏斜散射主导、强烈依赖温度的反常霍尔效应相比，红外克尔效应被证明是探测非共线反铁磁体 Berry 曲率的稳健局域手段。

item.title: 惯性自旋波的高效形式主义：以 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 反铁磁体为例
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 De-Yun Zhao, Ri-Xing Wang, Meng-Qiu Cai, Mikhail Cherkasskii, Peng-Bin He
该研究提出一种计算惯性自旋波的理论框架，并通过椭圆率角统一定义其手性和偏振性质。作者将该方法应用于含交错与均匀 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的单轴反铁磁体，涵盖均匀共线、倾斜和螺旋磁结构。结果显示，小的交错 DMI 保持自旋波简并，而小的均匀 DMI 会解除简并；在进一步破缺时空反演对称性的结构中，自旋波简并可在整个布里渊区被完全解除。

item.title: Kitaev-J3 模型中去禁闭磁有序的证据
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jiucai Wang, Chuan Chen
该研究结合变分蒙特卡洛计算和母态 Kitaev 自旋液体的 vison 准粒子分析，研究蜂窝晶格 Kitaev-J3 模型。结果表明，锯齿形或反铁磁有序可与继承自 Kitaev 自旋液体的残余 Z2 拓扑结构共存，形成去禁闭磁性相。作者认为磁有序可由 vison 对凝聚产生，而单个 vison 仍保持能隙，从而提供一种磁有序不必立即导致禁闭的微观机制，并可能解释若干 Kitaev 材料中的低温热输运异常。

item.title: 反铁磁 MnTe₂ 中磁振子能带的格纹状自旋劈裂与手性
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Dirk Wulferding, Daehyeon An, Jiwon Choi, Dongmin Mun, Youngsu Choi, Sivasakthi Kuppusamy, Sritharan Krishnamoorthi, Raman Sankar, Myung Joon Han, Se Kwon Kim, Kwang-Yong Choi
该研究利用螺旋度和角分辨 Raman 散射揭示 MnTe₂ 中磁振子的降低旋转对称性以及左右圆偏振通道之间的显著不平衡，表明存在动量依赖的磁振子手性。第一性原理 DFT+U 计算结合线性自旋波理论发现，其动量空间中具有特征性的格纹状自旋劈裂结构。研究表明，这些磁振子自旋纹理由 MnTe₂ 的非常规子晶格对称性决定，并与交替磁性电子能带的自旋纹理相似。

item.title: 由结构手性与磁手性耦合产生的自旋—轨道p波磁性
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tom G. Saunderson, Börge Göbel, Ersoy Şaşioğlu, Samir Lounis
该工作指出，螺旋自旋织构是p波磁性的最小实现，其特征是动量奇的自旋极化；而结构手性晶体则因反演对称性破缺产生动量奇的轨道极化。作者证明自旋—轨道耦合能够连接这两种微观手性，使手性晶体的轨道极化为p波自旋劈裂提供额外贡献。由此形成的自旋—轨道态可按相对手性分类，产生同手性和异手性两类对称性不同的p波相，并可通过纵向电导的输运特征直接探测。

item.title: kagome 反铁磁体中的动力学自旋关联：超越平均场的 Abrikosov 费米子与 Schwinger 玻色子方法比较
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Daiki Sasamoto, Joji Nasu
该研究比较了 Abrikosov 费米子和 Schwinger 玻色子两种 parton 方法在 kagome 反铁磁 Heisenberg 模型自旋动力学中的结果，并考虑与 herbertsmithite 相关的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用。作者关注动力学自旋结构因子、分数化准粒子以及耦合规范结构之间的关系。该工作旨在澄清 kagome 量子自旋液体激发谱中自旋能隙和规范结构等长期争议问题。

item.title: 压力稳定的 MnSb₂ 及其复杂非公度磁有序
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Mingyu Xu, Matt Boswell, Qing-Ping Ding, Cheng Peng, Aashish Sapkota, Qiang Zhang, Danielle Yahne, Sergey. L. Bud'ko, Yuji Furukawa, Paul. C. Canfield, Raquel A. Ribeiro, Weiwei Xie
该工作报道了白铁矿型化合物 MnSb₂ 的高压稳定合成及磁性表征，该化合物在常压下热力学上处于亚稳态。单晶通过立方多砧压机合成，X 射线衍射确认其为正交 Pnnm 结构，并在常压下可长期稳定至约 450–500 K。热容测量显示约 220 K 和 118 K 处存在相变，中子衍射揭示 220 K 以下出现非常规磁基态；粉末中子衍射精修支持多种可能磁构型，其中多数与自旋密度波描述相符。

item.title: 逆法拉第效应诱导的铋铁石榴石 Mie 球中自旋波杂化
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Fedor Shuklin, Khristina Albitskaya, Alexander Chernov, Mihail Petrov
本文表明，逆法拉第效应可用于调控铁磁性铋铁石榴石 Mie 球中的偶极-交换自旋波谱。内部光学 Mie 共振产生具有空间结构的有效磁场，其对称性继承自光学近场，并可作为磁振子哈密顿量的可控微扰。在圆偏振光沿平衡磁化方向入射时，该扰动保持轴对称但破坏镜面对称，从而使同一角动量扇区内奇偶性相反的磁振子模式发生杂化；理论与数值结果显示能级劈裂随泵浦强度线性增加，并在光学 Mie 共振附近增强。

item.title: 二维反铁磁量子临界点处的交错自旋磁化率
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Y. Itoh
该文在包含零点量子涨落的二维反铁磁自旋涨落自洽重整化理论中，研究量子临界点处有限温度交错自旋磁化率随模-模耦合常数 y₁ 的变化。作者发现 y₁=0.1 可作为区分零点自旋涨落影响的判据：弱耦合时表现为 Curie 定律，强耦合时则呈 Curie-Weiss 型或幂律型温度依赖。对于弱模-模耦合体系，Curie-Weiss 温度的缺失可作为识别量子临界点的依据，并通过核自旋-晶格弛豫率分析应用于若干层状巡游反铁磁体系。

item.title: Ravines in quantum cost landscapes: opportunities for improved VQA predictions
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Felix J. Beckmann, João F. Bravo
arXiv:2607.01329v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The geometric and topological structure of quantum cost landscapes (QCLs) governs the optimization and thus the predictive power of variational quantum algorithms (VQAs). We systematically analyze ravines - low-cost paths connecting local minima - using an adapted version of the nudged elastic band (NEB) algorithm, a method originating from theoretical chemistry. By training quantum neural networks (QNNs) to classify the concentratable entanglement of quantum states, we apply the NEB algorithm and numerically identify ravine structures in QCLs of hardware-efficient ansatzes. item.title: Frequency Shift Physics-Informed Extreme Learning Machine for Solving High-Frequency Partial Differential Equations
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xiong Xiong, Ruonan Zhai, Zheng Zeng, Sheng Zhou, Rongchun Hu, Zichen Deng
arXiv:2607.01694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solving partial differential equations (PDEs) with high-frequency solutions remains a central challenge in physics-informed machine learning due to spectral bias -- the tendency of neural networks to learn low-frequency components preferentially. This paper proposes a Frequency Shift Physics-Informed Extreme Learning Machine (FS-PIELM) framework that addresses this limitation through an additive mechanism for weight initialization. Rather than multiplying random weights by a scaling factor, the method translates the mean of the Gaussian weight distribution while keeping the variance fixed at unity, thereby avoiding the variance amplification inherent in scaling-based methods. Two variants are developed: FS-PIELM-L assigns independent frequen…

item.title: 量子储备池计算的热力学
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Lixiang Ding, Xingze Qiu
该文建立了一个非平衡热力学框架，将受驱开放量子系统的宏观预测性能与微观能量代价联系起来。作者通过将 Holevo 容量映射到 Bogoliubov-Kubo-Mori 几何流形，说明量子临界区域的计算峰值源于能隙闭合导致的谱共振。研究进一步引入量子信息耗散来度量储备池保留的非预测性历史信息，并提出连续时间处理的广义 Landauer 界，揭示最优预测能力与不可逆耗散之间的基本权衡。

item.title: 具有全光控制和毫秒量子存储的金刚石过渡金属量子比特
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 I. M. Morris, T. Alberth, L. Crooks, T. Lühmann, D. J. Twitchen, S. Pezzagna, J. Meijer, S. S. Nicley, J. N. Becker
该研究展示了金刚石中过渡金属缺陷作为自旋-光子接口的潜力，兼具光学访问、相干控制和长寿命量子存储。作者利用单个带负电镍-空位中心实现全光控制的金刚石自旋量子比特，在 1.65 K 下相干时间超过 1 毫秒。通过 Raman Rabi 振荡、Ramsey 干涉和全光动力学解耦，研究将相干时间从亚微秒尺度延长至 1.27 ms，显示其适合集成化低温量子网络应用。

item.title: (2+1)D quantum electrodynamics at finite density on a quantum computer
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Emil Otis Rosanowski, Arianna Crippa, Lena Funcke, Paulo Vitor Itaborai, Karl Jansen, Simran Singh
arXiv:2509.20558v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this paper, we explore (2+1)D quantum electrodynamics (QED) at finite density on a quantum computer, including two fermion flavors. Our method employs an efficient gauge-invariant ansatz together with a quantum circuit structure that enforces Gauss's law. As a proof of principle, we benchmark our simulation protocol on a small lattice system, demonstrating the identification of phase transitions in terms of the particle number of the fermion flavors. Classical simulations are used to obtain optimized variational parameters, which are then deployed in inference runs on IBM quantum hardware. We conclude by discussing hardware limitations and prospects for scaling this method to larger systems.

item.title: Disorder-induced superconductivity in graphene
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jannes van Poppelen, Tomas Löthman, Annica M. Black-Schaffer
arXiv:2607.02267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Correlated phases of matter are typically investigated in crystalline systems, where disorder is considered to be detrimental. However, intriguing exceptions exist, such as superconductivity being enhanced in amorphous realizations of Al and Bi. Here, we demonstrate that superconductivity can even emerge entirely from disorder, using monolayer graphene as an example. In the clean limit, the semi-metallic nature of graphene requires prohibitively strong electronic interactions to achieve superconductivity. Despite the inherently random nature of disorder, we show that introducing low concentrations of vacancies or hydrogenation in graphene provides a large density of low-energy states that easily induce superconductivity. item.title: 具有人造单向堆垛层的块体晶体中的伊辛超导与反常金属态
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xiangqi Liu, Chen Xu, Haonan Wang, Runfeng Zhang, Ziyi Zhu, Zhengyang Li, Lianbing Wen, Ze Yan, Fanbo Shen, Jiawei Luo, Zhengtai Liu, Xia Wang, Leiming Chen, Ke Qu, Jianping Sun, Jinguang Cheng, Shiwei Wu, Zhenzhong Yang, Dawei Shen, Yanfeng Guo
该研究报道合成了 Sr0.75ClNbS2 超导体，在块体晶体中实现了单向平行 AA 堆垛的 NbS2 层结构。平面 Sr-Cl 网络驱动堆垛重组，使原本中心对称的 2H-NbS2 转变为非中心对称结构，从而在三维块体中保留类似单层的伊辛自旋轨道耦合与自旋劈裂能带。输运实验显示出强超导各向异性和较高的面内上临界场，表明该人工堆垛策略可用于构筑块体二维量子态。

item.title: Quantum mutual information as a robust probe of integrability in open quantum systems
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Nirupam Sen, Keshav Das Agarwal, Aditi Sen De
arXiv:2607.02462v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The dynamics of a quantum system encode signatures of whether the underlying Hamiltonian is integrable or chaotic, giving rise to the concept of quantum information scrambling through the properties of the resulting dynamical states or operators. We introduce an information-theoretic framework based on the Haar-averaged sum of total correlations (aSTC), together with average genuine multipartite entanglement generated dynamically from initially fully separable states, as robust probes of quantum information scrambling. item.title: MAPbI3 钙钛矿晶体中由光取向空穴引起的核自旋共振冷却
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Mladen Kotur, Dmitri R. Yakovlev, Nataliia E. Kopteva, Bekir Turedi, Maksym V. Kovalenko, Manfred Bayer

👤 Masoud Abedini, Chunwei Zhang, Linnan Zhang, Ardashir Mouhamadzadeh, Masoomeh Barmaki
钢筋混凝土结构在爆炸荷载下的损伤评估通常依赖理论方法、实验或数值模拟，但实验成本高、建模复杂且计算开销大。本文提出五种机器学习模型预测爆炸荷载作用下钢筋混凝土柱的损伤等级，包括随机森林、LightGBM、CatBoost、XGBoost和支持向量机。模型训练与测试数据来自有限元模型，结果表明CatBoost在该任务中表现最优，显示机器学习可为爆炸损伤快速评估提供有效工具。

item.title: On the Symplectic Propagation of the Spin-MInt Algorithm for Non-Adiabatic Quantum Dynamics
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 James R. Rampton, Lauren E. Cook, Timothy J. H. Hele
arXiv:2607.02058v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mapping methods are often used for the numerical simulation of nonadiabatic systems by propagating classical mapping variable trajectories. A recently popularised mapping method is spin-mapping, whose mapping variables arise from quantum mechanical operators with symmetries described by a Lie-Poisson algebra. Simulating the classical-like dynamics of spin-mapping systems accurately is generally challenging, with many methods unable to preserve the underlying geometric structure of the symplectic form. The Spin-MInt algorithm is a recently proposed algorithm propagating spin-mapping variables, with a direct proof of symplecticity existing only for 2 electronic states. item.title: Spin-Weighted Spherical Harmonics Enable Complete and Scalable E(3)-Equivariant Networks
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Chenxing Liang, Yuchao Lin, Andrii Kryvenko, Wendi Yu, Chuan Li, Jianwen Xie, Xiaofeng Qian, Shuiwang Ji
arXiv:2607.01408v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: E(3)-equivariant networks are promising for 3D atomistic system modeling, yet their scalability is limited by the O(L⁶⁾ complexity of the Clebsch-Gordan Tensor Product (CGTP). The recently proposed Gaunt Tensor Product (GTP) reduces the complexity but is unable to capture the antisymmetric paths, resulting in incomplete expressivity. In this work, we present SpinGTP, an approach to overcome the GTP incompleteness by generalizing from scalar functions to Spin-Weighted Spherical Harmonics (SWSH). By relying on the algebraic properties of SWSH, SpinGTP recovers the missing antisymmetric interactions while maintaining the asymptotic efficiency of GTP.
